title: Recursive Semantic Divergence for LLM Agent Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2610.33012v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents with tool use exhibit inconsistent behavior across independent runs from identical states, calling different tools, producing contradictory outputs, or pursuing divergent strategies. This variability compounds over time and undermines deployment reliability. Existing evaluation metrics primarily measure task correctness via completion-based scores and do not capture consistency in agent behavior across executions. Separately, agent behavior is analyzed either at the token level using probability distributions or at the single-response level using semantic clustering, but neither captures how inconsistency propagates across future turns of a trajectory. We introduce Recursive Semantic Divergence (RSD), an unsupervised trajectory-level consistency metric adapted from bisimulation metrics in reinforcement learning. RSD measures the expected cumulative semantic disagreement between two independent rollouts

translated_title: 面向LLM智能体一致性的递归语义散度
translated_abstract: 使用工具的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在相同状态下的独立运行中会表现出不一致的行为，例如调用不同的工具、产生矛盾的输出或采取分歧的策略。这种变异性会随时间累积并削弱部署的可靠性。现有的评估指标主要通过基于完成度的分数来衡量任务正确性，而无法捕捉智能体行为在多次执行之间的一致性。此外，对智能体行为的分析要么在词元层面使用概率分布，要么在单次响应层面使用语义聚类，但两者都无法捕捉不一致性如何在轨迹的未来轮次中传播。我们提出了递归语义散度（RSD），这是一种改编自强化学习中双模拟度量的无监督轨迹级一致性指标。RSD衡量两个独立运行之间的预期累积语义分歧
tldr: 该论文提出了递归语义散度（RSD），一种改编自强化学习双模拟度量的无监督轨迹级一致性指标，用于衡量LLM智能体在独立运行中的行为不一致性及其在轨迹中的传播。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Recursive Semantic Divergence (RSD), an unsupervised trajectory-level consistency metric adapted from bisimulation metrics in reinforcement learning, to quantify behavioral inconsistency of LLM agents across independent runs.
